title: To-dos from your notes
promise: Write your to-dos between your normal notes, as you always do. Your agent keeps them in your favourite to-do app. Tick one on paper, and it is done there too.
instruction: From now on, as you transcribe my pen notes, maintain my to-dos in Apple Reminders.
note: Apple Reminders is an example. Use the name of your own to-do app.
